internal_alignment: Organize, represent, and interpret data with up to three categories; ask and answer questions about the total number of data points, how many in each category, and how many more or less are in one category than in another. Internal record only; no standards codes appear on any child page, and no separate answer key is published for this pack.
model_accuracy: Exactly three categories on every page; one symbol always means one object; every fixed total within 20. Page 1 fruit jumble: 6 apples, 4 bananas, 5 oranges (15 in all), each count asserted from the jumble layout; tally example shows a full group of five. Page 2 votes: Dogs 7, Cats 5, Fish 3 (15 votes); 15 cut-out tokens and 15 work-area paste boxes, one per vote; token cells sized to the artwork including fish tails and cat whiskers. Page 3 ball graph: Red 8, Blue 6, Green 4 (18 in all); most is Red; red minus green is 4. Page 4 toy graph: Cars 8, Teddy bears 5, Blocks 6; cars minus bears is 3, cars minus blocks is 2, cars plus blocks is 14. The bottom matching aid is a generic 3 vs 2 example with exactly 1 extra, matching no answer on the page. Page 5 survey is open-ended: graph rows hold up to 10 boxes each; any respondent count from 1 to 10 works, and ties for the most votes are accepted as correct.
